findings.title: Patch_WakeOnUnfog's 'mid-generation' guard does not exclude map generation
findings.detail: The postfix returns early only when ProgramState != Playing or the map is not in Find.Maps. A dungeon map is generated during play, and vanilla adds it to Find.Maps (MapGenerator.cs:146) before running gen steps (line 186). So GenStep_Fog's FloodUnfog calls (after TUBAD_DungeonLayout has already planned packs) wake and spawn packs during generation, before the map's final setup (FinalizeInit) and inside the seeded Rand. That contradicts the comment 'Mid-generation reveals are left to the tick fallback'. Add `|| MapGenerator.mapBeingGenerated == map` to the early return at Source/DungeonCreatures.cs:231. Not a must: vanilla gen steps also spawn pawns and make lords, so no exception is expected.

findings.title: Packs can now spawn inside an arriving party pawn's spawn setup
findings.detail: Pawn.SpawnSetup calls FloodFillerFog.FloodUnfog for a player pawn spawned on a fogged cell. With this postfix, the entrance pack is spawned and given a lord partway through the first party member's spawn setup, before the rest of the party spawns. Nothing here looks like it throws; it is a reentrancy path the tick fallback did not have.

findings.title: Trigger_PawnHarmed fires on harm from any source, not only the party
findings.detail: SignalIsHarm accepts PawnDamaged with external violence and PawnLost Killed/Incapped from any instigator, so a dungeon-mad pack hurting a mech or insect pack sends the whole pack to AssaultColony after the party. If the intent is 'until they engage the party', pass requireInstigatorWithSpecificFaction: Faction.OfPlayer.

findings.title: A dweller already urgently hungry at its first eyeing gets almost no grace
findings.detail: Vanilla reaches BestPawnToHuntForPredator without gating on hunger category, so the warning blocks one search and the next search, possibly seconds later, hunts if CurCategory >= UrgentlyHungry. The summary's 'there is time to drop food' only holds when the first eyeing happens while merely Hungry.
